S00_BOOTSTRAP.summary: The imported control pack verified all 36 immutable files, validated both committed fixtures, initialized a persistent workflow ledger, and captured the initial Git branch, revision, and dirty state.
S00_BOOTSTRAP.title: Bootstrap control pack and repository run

S01_REPOSITORY_DISCOVERY.summary: Discovery traced the public local-ingest route through the worker, current Relex runtime, Mongo authority, and projection control plane; it also classified each retained, extended, replaced, and removed seam before product edits.
S01_REPOSITORY_DISCOVERY.title: Discover actual repository seams and produce change map

S02_FROZEN_BASELINE.summary: The frozen production Relex extractor processed both committed Markdown fixtures twice with zero failures; each fixture reproduced identical counts, extraction identity, and logical projection digests.
S02_FROZEN_BASELINE.title: Capture executable Relex baseline on both fixtures

S03_GOLD_ENTITY_SYNTAX_CEILING.summary: Exact quality-fixture entity spans traversed the complete deterministic syntax lane twice with one spaCy parse per evidence group, zero model calls, and an identical digest; gold pair recall is 0.787234 and activates the grammar-only full benchmark path.
S03_GOLD_ENTITY_SYNTAX_CEILING.title: Run gold-entity deterministic relation ceiling kill switch

S04_SURVEY_CONTRACTS_OFFSETS.summary: Added strict versioned contracts for all Graphify stages, loss-aware normalization with reversible source boundaries, and a deterministic zero-model survey; both fixtures were surveyed and the 598-test regression passed.
S04_SURVEY_CONTRACTS_OFFSETS.title: Implement zero-model survey, normalized offset space, and typed contracts

S05_GLINER2_CPU_PROVIDER.summary: Installed and pinned the sole candidate GLiNER2 provider, verified the exact checkpoint, enforced CPU-only parameters and buffers, and proved that repeated registry access uses one provider and one warm model without fallback.
S05_GLINER2_CPU_PROVIDER.title: Install the sole CPU-only GLiNER2 entity provider

S06_ENTITY_CENSUS_RAW_MENTIONS.summary: Implemented structural census windows, deterministic length-bucketed CPU batches of eight, exact local/normalized/original offset checks, and immediate append-only persistence; both fixtures conserved all 1,717 predictions with zero alignment failures.
S06_ENTITY_CENSUS_RAW_MENTIONS.title: Implement corpus-batched entity census and raw mention conservation

S07_DOCUMENT_ENTITY_REDUCER.summary: Implemented uncapped document-local clustering and four-lane adjudication using model, context, type, definition, alias, recurrence, shape, and ambiguity evidence; all 1,640 aligned mentions received one terminal assignment and repeated runs matched exactly.
S07_DOCUMENT_ENTITY_REDUCER.title: Implement document-local entity clustering and quality adjudication
